meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先判断你给的来源属于哪一类,再用对应工具抓取内容,把它整理成一个 AI 技能;需要时还能增强、打包,或导出到向量数据库。
howto.when: 当你想从文档站、GitHub 仓库、PDF 等来源做出一份 AI 技能,或要更新、导出已有技能时触发。

say.text: 把 https://docs.example.com 这个文档站做成一个技能
say.note: 会自动识别为文档源并抓取

say.note: 改用 GitHub 抓取工具

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude detects which type of source you give, scrapes it with the matching tool, and builds an AI skill. It can also enhance, package, and export skills to vector databases.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to create an AI skill from a docs site, GitHub repo, PDF, or video, or to update or export existing skills.

say_en.text: Turn the docs site https://docs.example.com into a skill
say_en.note: Detects the docs source and scrapes it
